title: Daily Transfer Limits of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Across a Worker's Plans
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.** When a worker holds two plans, the per-day dollar limit and the per-day transfer count apply to the worker, not to each plan: transfers booked on the same Eastern Time calendar day under both plans are added together and compared with the daily dollar ceiling and the transfers-per-day count of the higher-ranked of the two plans. The access percentage, the pay-period caps, fees and recoveries stay per plan, each computed from that plan's own earnings, transfers and employer program. A worker with one plan is measured against that plan's own per-day limits in the same way.

## The day's measures

- **Day's transfer total** — the amount of the early wage transfers booked today, Eastern Time, across every plan the worker holds, a returned transfer excluded.
- **Day's transfer count** — the number of those transfers, a returned transfer excluded.
- **Per-day room** — the daily dollar ceiling less the day's transfer total.

## Condition and result

| Situation | Daily ceiling and count compared against | What stays per plan |
|---|---|---|
| One plan | that plan's own daily ceiling and count | everything else |
| Two plans | the higher-ranked plan's daily ceiling and count, against both plans' transfers of the day together | access percentage, pay-period caps, fees, recoveries |

## Hypothetical illustration

A worker holds one plan on Paystride Access Plus and one on Paystride Access Preferred. The higher-ranked is Paystride Access Preferred, whose daily ceiling is 300.00 USD and whose count is three transfers. Having booked 70.00 USD under the first plan and 95.50 USD under the second today, none returned, the day's total is 165.50 USD and the per-day room is 134.50 USD; two transfers count toward the daily three.
